conditions.description: For gb01 the view lists the dataset count and GBP total next to the FO count and -1 times the FO AMOUNTMST total; the FO side keeps TRANSTYPE 15 rows (including a cancelled payment and a corporate account) and leaves out the test account and TRANSTYPE 8 and 24 rows.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-014: AMOUNTMST is GBP. CUSTTRANS, tblContact_Test_Records and fact_contact_payment faked. Test record 'T900001'. CUSTTRANS gb01: RECID 1001 C100001 T15 AMOUNTMST -100.00; 1002 C100002 T15 -50.00 CANCELLEDPAYMENT 1; 1003 ACME01 T15 +30.00; 1004 T900001 T15 -999.00; 1005 C100001 T8 -500.00; 1006 C100001 T24 -700.00. Dataset gb01: 1001 100.00, 1002 50.00, 1003 -30.00.
conditions.expected: Exactly one row: legal_entity 'gb01', dataset_row_count 3, fo_row_count 3, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 120.000000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 120.000000, is_reconciled 1.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-001 gb01 reconciles with test account and other transtypes excluded from FO side]

conditions.description: Two legal entities are reconciled separately, one row each; the FO side uses AMOUNTMST (not AMOUNTCUR) and excludes a test-account row in us01.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-002 one row per legal entity with each entity reconciled separately]

conditions.description: Row counts differ while GBP totals agree: the flag must show not reconciled.
conditions.expected: One row: gb01, dataset_row_count 2, fo_row_count 3, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 150.000000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 150.000000, is_reconciled 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-003 row count mismatch with equal totals is not reconciled]

conditions.description: Row counts agree while GBP totals differ: the flag must show not reconciled.
conditions.expected: One row: gb01, 2, 2, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 149.990000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 150.000000, is_reconciled 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-004 amount mismatch with equal counts is not reconciled]

conditions.description: A legal entity with in-scope FO payments but no dataset rows still appears, with the dataset side 0.
conditions.preconditions: CUSTTRANS T15: gb01 5001 -100.00; us01 5002 AMOUNTMST -40.00. Dataset: gb01 5001 100.00 only.
conditions.expected: Two rows: gb01 1, 1, 100.000000, 100.000000, 1; us01 dataset_row_count 0, fo_row_count 1, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 0.000000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 40.000000, is_reconciled 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-005 legal entity only in FO shows with dataset side zero and not reconciled]

conditions.description: A legal entity with dataset rows but no FO payments still appears, with the FO side 0.
conditions.expected: Two rows: gb01 1, 1, 100.000000, 100.000000, 1; ie01 dataset_row_count 1, fo_row_count 0, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 10.000000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 0.000000, is_reconciled 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-006 legal entity only in dataset shows with FO side zero and not reconciled]

conditions.description: FO rows with a null ACCOUNTNUM or a null AMOUNTMST are in scope and counted (nulls carried through as recorded), and a null apuk_contactnumber in the test list does not drop in-scope FO rows; the test account is still excluded.
conditions.preconditions: Test records 'T900001' and NULL. CUSTTRANS gb01 T15: 7001 ACCOUNTNUM NULL AMOUNTMST -100.00; 7002 C100001 AMOUNTMST NULL; 7003 T900001 -999.00. Dataset gb01: 7001 100.00; 7002 NULL.
conditions.expected: One row: gb01, dataset_row_count 2, fo_row_count 2, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 100.000000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 100.000000, is_reconciled 1.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-007 null account number and null amount rows are counted and test list null does not drop rows]

conditions.description: Totals are compared at FO's six decimal places with no rounding: an exact six-decimal match reconciles, a 0.000001 difference does not.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-023: FO six-decimal precision kept. CUSTTRANS T15: gb01 8001 AMOUNTMST -10.123456; us01 8002 AMOUNTMST -10.000001. Dataset: gb01 8001 10.123456; us01 8002 10.000000.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-008 totals compared at six decimals without rounding]

conditions.description: A payment and a refund that net to zero give totals of 0 on both sides and reconcile.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-009 payment and refund netting to zero reconcile at 0]

conditions.description: Two identical FO payments with different RECIDs are both counted on the FO side (no de-duplication), and a test account listed twice in the test records neither multiplies nor lets through FO rows.
conditions.expected: One row: gb01, dataset_row_count 2, fo_row_count 2, dataset_amount_paid_gbp 150.000000, fo_amount_paid_gbp 150.000000, is_reconciled 1.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD003].[test TC-003-010 identical FO payments both counted and duplicate test records do not multiply rows]
